description: CI time budget (CODING_STANDARDS.md, CI time budget). A test or script slower than its budget fails CI unless it is listed under 'exceptions' with the reason it cannot be faster. Make the test faster before adding an exception: inject the clock or timeout instead of waiting it out, shrink benchmark iterations, share expensive setup. Budgets apply on the hosted runners (GitHub Actions); local runs only report the slowest entries. gx-engine's per-test limit lives in src/gx-engine/.config/nextest.toml.
